# A window inside a window is what every backend already refuses -- html,
# bubbletea and android each panic with "unexpected nested Window" and fyne and
# gtk4 fall into irwalk's generic one. It is reported instead, whichever route
# put it there.

# Written that way, it is the ordinary tree error: a window's rest slot accepts
# `node` and a window is a member of the root family.
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=fyne --out=out1 direct.sngl
stderr 'direct.sngl:10:8: expected node component in window, got window'

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out3 direct.sngl
stderr 'expected node component in window, got window'

# Inlining is the other route, and it is now refused a phase earlier: #214 gave
# a component's body the same tree question every other position was already
# asked, so `component inner node { window … }` is reported where it is written
# rather than where it is spliced. passWindowNesting is what caught it before,
# and is left in place for the shapes a lowering pass can still synthesize.
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=fyne --out=out2 viacomponent.sngl
stderr 'viacomponent.sngl:10:8: expected node component in the body of inner, got window'

# A component that declares a window is fine where the window itself would be,
# which is the root of a file -- so it names the root family.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=fyne --out=out4 toplevel.sngl
exists out4/model.go

-- direct.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output {
	go {
		fyne
	}
}

window(title = "w") {
	window(title = "b") {
		text(value = "x")
	}
}

-- viacomponent.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output {
	go {
		fyne
	}
}

component inner node {
	window(title = "b") {
		text(value = "x")
	}
}

window(title = "w") {
	inner()
}

-- toplevel.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output {
	go {
		fyne
	}
}

component inner root {
	window(title = "b") {
		text(value = "x")
	}
}

inner()
